def: An engineer who delivers a working, measured and safe system in which a learned model does part of the work.
A large pretrained model that is adapted or called for many tasks rather than trained from scratch for each one.
The adjustable numbers inside a model that training changes to reduce the loss.
A number that scores how wrong a model's predictions are on the data; training tries to make it small.
The vector of partial derivatives of the loss with respect to each parameter, pointing in the direction of steepest increase.
Training by repeatedly moving the parameters a small step against the gradient of the loss.
The size of the step taken along the negative gradient at each update.
